title: Grateful Dead Live at The Music Box on 1969-02-04
lineage: SBD > CM > C > D > CD > EAC > shntool > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy ’69 show with smoking Dark Star, Morning Dew and a killer Other One/Alligator→Caution sequence, captured on a fuzzy but listenable soundboard tape.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised – the band rolls through a scorching Schoolgirl opener, a dynamic Dark Star > St. Stephen > Eleven, a soaring Morning Dew and an inspired Other One that segues into Alligator and a beautiful Caution jam. The recording is a sound‑board source that suffers from tape speed issues, hiss and occasional loss of drums, yet the mix remains usable and many listeners find the muddies add vintage charm.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and highlight exceptional musical moments; recording flaws are noted but not enough to outweigh the show’s quality, resulting in a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fuzzy/muddy tape with noticeable hiss and occasional loss of drums; tape runs fast (pitch shift on Dark Star) and has cuts at Schoolgirl start, Feedback end, and missing 'Bid You Goodnight' segment. Overall mix is balanced enough to hear all instruments, organ sits deep in the back.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds quickly with a raunchy GMLSG and a tight Dark Star/Eleven combo; second set ramps up with an extended Other One, seamless segue into Alligator and a soaring Caution jam, closing with a wild Feedback jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for superb guitar work, dynamic phrasing on Dark Star and beautiful leads into Caution; occasional miscue noted but quickly recovered.
band_member_comments.Keys: Organ is described as deep in the mix and audible despite overall muddiness.
band_member_comments.Drums: Early portions of the tape lose drum detail, but later sections feature “nice drums” with Mickey and Bill clearly enjoying themselves.
